payload.title: Pinned versions for M2 (ADR 0006)
payload.context: CLAUDE.md asks for the current stable version of each dependency, checked at pinning time. Versions were looked up on 2026-11-23. See docs/adr/0006-pinned-versions.md.
payload.rationale: PHP 8.5 not 8.6 because phpredis does not build against 8.6 yet; Redis 8.10 not 8.12 because 8.12 had no official image; Node 24 from the Alpine package; frontend tooling as shipped by the starter kit; Larastan level 7.
payload.consequences: Laravel 13, FrankenPHP 1.14, PostgreSQL 19, Redis 8.10. Caret ranges with lock files; Docker images pinned to a minor version. Move to PHP 8.6 once phpredis supports it; Larastan level 8 once domain models exist.
